knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The bookings are rebuilt from their steps. The skin check and the clean-down are kept, because a short schedule must not remove required steps.
Absence from a list is not an exemption. The council and state position is not established and must be checked.
A recurring package states its frequency, services, price basis, missed-appointment rule and cancellation rule.

practicalCriteria: Assessor checks a sample booking for arrival, set-up, consultation, bath or dry, clip, skin check, clean-down, handover and travel time
Assessor checks a sample package for the five required terms
Assessor observes the candidate state the council and state position for a named area and name the check to make
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Sample booking record with step times
Sample package terms with the consumer-law check recorded
Council and state position record for the named area, with source and date
stopWorkCriteria: A groom is booked with time only for the clip
A mobile grooming service is offered in an area where the position has not been checked
